extracted.name: Chicken nuggets GF DF
extracted.description: My daughter wants chicken nuggets, my wife needs gluten free, so here is the final product. Turned out really tasty.
ingredient_lines: 2 tsp each of garlic powder, onion powder, paprika,
1/2 tsp each sage, coriander, all spice
instruction_lines: Cut the chicken into nugget size pieces
In a gallon size Ziploc bag, put all other ingredients. Toss chicken in breading mixture.
In a large pan, with a bit of olive oil, fry chicken until cooked through.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce, and if that's not G. Hughes Cluckin Sauce I don't know what you're doing with your life.
